value.rationale: The double-scaling entanglement survival window is a natural physically motivated refinement of finite-squeezing domes: strongly squeezed baths erase entanglement at fixed nonzero hopping but permit a finite resource through J proportional to e^{-2r}. The sharp thermal feasibility threshold and logarithmically divergent squeezing requirement distinguish possible from impossible reservoir-engineering settings, and the nonattained universal bound provides a real optimization constraint rather than an arbitrary sampled parameter.
